run1_preserved.why_preserved: so a reviewer can reproduce both readings; no data criterion is relaxed by this amendment

defects_found_in_run1_instrument.defect: Run 1 used author_asserts_supports as the third HF-14 predicate. That is a substantive per-row ledger field carried by 60/62 rows, not an HF-14 acceptance-vocabulary key. The lead's artifact (reviews/L0-review-final-verify.json) and the controller predicate scan define the triple as status / validation_status / supports_claim, none of which occur in any of the 62 rows.
defects_found_in_run1_instrument.fix: Correct the third predicate to status. Additionally record author_asserts_supports as an informational presence count so the corrected triple cannot hide it.
defects_found_in_run1_instrument.effect_on_data: Run 1 falsely reported a nonzero HF-14 count and failed C7. Corrected triple is expected 0/62 for all three keys, matching the lead's claim.

defects_found_in_run1_instrument.defect: Run 1 deduped only on event_id, then review_id, then (reviewer, created_at, verdict). One physical review arriving as a reviews/*.json file (review_id only, e.g. L0-review-075-2026-09-12T00:49:01+08:00) and as an accepted-stream record (event_id only, w075-l0rev3-review) produced two union records for the same reviewer and review. Run 1 therefore counted 6 accept rows for 4 distinct accept reviewers.
defects_found_in_run1_instrument.fix: Add a cross-source secondary identity key (reviewer, created_at, verdict). Records agreeing on that key are merged even when their primary keys differ; all origins are retained and the merge is recorded in merge_provenance. Explicit counts_as_full_schema_verdict=True wins over an absent value when merging.
defects_found_in_run1_instrument.effect_on_data: Accept row count drops from 6 to 4 (distinct reviewers unchanged at 4: worker-050/072/075/079).

defects_found_in_run1_instrument.defect: Run 1 admitted any is_l0 record, including artifacts that carry no verdict field (reviews/L0-review-final-verify.json has adjudicated_verdict, not verdict; the two lead adjudication files likewise). One such record entered the headline as by_verdict['None']=1.
defects_found_in_run1_instrument.fix: A union record must carry verdict in {accept, revise, reject, inconclusive} to be a verdict record. Records failing that test are excluded and listed separately under excluded_non_verdict with their binding class, so the exclusion is auditable.
defects_found_in_run1_instrument.effect_on_data: Removes the lead's own adjudication artifact from the census corpus.

defects_found_in_run1_instrument.defect: Not an instrument defect: a finding. Run 1 compared the lead's stated full_schema value (False for worker-072 and worker-050) against the raw record value (null/absent) and reported match=false. The controller's own rule, research_map/astra_lifecycle.py:195, is full = (counts_as_full_schema_verdict is not False), i.e. an absent flag defaults to full. Under that rule the lead's False labels for those two rows are contradicted, and the hash-bound full-accept set at a1674f094979 is 4 distinct non-author reviewers, not 2.
defects_found_in_run1_instrument.fix: Keep the strict raw-value comparison as lead_row.match_full_flag, and add full_by_controller_rule computed exactly as astra_lifecycle.py:195 defines it. Report the discrepancy as finding L0U-01 rather than silently normalising it.
defects_found_in_run1_instrument.effect_on_data: None on the accept reviewer set. It changes the labelled full-accept count and is reported as a major finding.

defects_found_in_run1_instrument.defect: Not an instrument defect: a method note confirmed by reading research_map/astra_lifecycle.py:160-173 and 185-207. _explicit_pins reads only artifact_sha256/reviewed_sha256/sha256/cited_sha256, so a path#sha256 reference embedded in target_id is invisible to the controller scan; and the scan reads reviews/*.json only, so accepted-stream-only verdicts are invisible to it. This explains why a file scan and an event-inclusive census can disagree without either being dishonest.
defects_found_in_run1_instrument.fix: Report both corpora explicitly (files-only and union) in the amended report.
defects_found_in_run1_instrument.effect_on_data: Adds a files_only view alongside the union view.

criteria_change.C7: HF-14 triple is now status / validation_status / supports_claim; author_asserts_supports is recorded informationally and is not part of the criterion.
criteria_change.C5: split into C5a lead_row_present_and_core_match (reviewer, verdict, score) and C5b lead_row_full_flag_matches_record (strict raw value).
criteria_change.C9: new, informational: for every lead coverage row, record full_by_controller_rule and whether it equals the lead's stated value.

decision_rule_unchanged_for_gate_purpose.L0_UNION_CONFIRMED: C1-C4, C5a, C6, C7, C8 pass; all four lead rows present with core match; >=2 distinct EXACT non-lead reviewers carrying an explicit full-schema accept; every headline accept binds the primary-source ledger.
decision_rule_unchanged_for_gate_purpose.L0_UNION_DIVERGENT: any lead row absent or core-mismatched, or any headline accept not primary-source bound, or <2 distinct explicit full-schema non-lead accepts.
decision_rule_unchanged_for_gate_purpose.note: A C5b/C9 full-flag discrepancy is reported as finding L0U-01 and does not by itself flip the decision, because the gate basis named by the lead (worker-075 + worker-079, both explicit full) is independently reproduced. It does change the labelled count and is flagged for the r3 / G-LIT adjudication.
